text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I headed out into town looking for 
Fenomeno, who hadn't shown up even after 
training time had passed—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah! B-Boss... Could it be that you were 
searching for me...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! I helped a lost kid get to 
the police box, caught a runaway dog, and 
carried an elderly lady's bags, and before 
I knew it, it was this late...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, that was just an excuse, wasn't 
it? I am fully prepared to accept any 
disciplinary action!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While I judged there were plenty of 
extenuating circumstances, I made sure to 
firmly tell her to contact us beforehand 
next time."
